name: OpenAI Ads API Client
description: Preferred executable client for bounded mock or live read-only OpenAI Ads retrieval and non-persisting Conversions API validation.

operational.connected_system: OpenAI Advertiser API and Ads Conversions API
capabilities: Read bounded ad-account metadata, campaigns, ads, and account or entity insights.
Verify an account-scoped Ads API key against the provider ad-account endpoint.
Validate conversion batches locally or through non-persisting provider validation.
auth_required: OPENAI_ADS_API_KEY for live Advertiser API reads
OPENAI_ADS_PIXEL_ID and OPENAI_ADS_CONVERSIONS_API_KEY for optional remote conversion validation
operational.approval_boundary: Advertiser operations are GET-only; bounded Conversions API requests force validate_only true and cannot persist events.

requires_setup: For live reads, create an account-scoped key in OpenAI Ads Manager and bind OPENAI_ADS_API_KEY outside agent context.
Configure separate pixel and Conversions API credentials only when provider-side validate-only checks are required.
limitations: Mock mode is immediately runnable, but provider-backed readiness requires an available account-scoped API key.
The provider account endpoint attests the account binding, not the individual human owner of an API key.
Campaign, ad-group, ad, file, feed, and persisted conversion mutations are intentionally excluded.
Automatic pagination, retries, and rate-limit backoff are not included.

authentication.credential_storage: The account-scoped API key remains in an explicitly bound runtime environment source and is never written into the package or readiness profile.
authentication.validation: The packaged driver calls GET /ad_account and accepts only the provider-returned account identifier as identity evidence.
authentication.revocation: Revoke or rotate the account-scoped API key in OpenAI Ads Manager and remove its runtime binding.
